app.name: HEC Emergency Fund
app.tagline: From the herd to the cheque

cb.title: Field reporter workspace
cb.subtitle: Open new cases, upload evidence, submit incident reports. Works for both CB (Chef de Brigade) and DP (Delegué Provincial).

ab.title: AB Entheos — Step 2
ab.subtitle: Operational validation. May release first-aid (20%) for urgent cases.

queue.title: My queue
queue.empty: No cases at your step right now.

dgfap.title: Amount-decider
dgfap.subtitle: Review the DGFC proposed amount, authorize or set a new amount, then verify to send to the Minister.
dgfap.empty: No cases at step 5 right now.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.subtitle_super: Full system access: users, forms, audit, payments, system settings.
admin.subtitle: Form definitions, audit, reports, payments.

stages.title: Approval committee overview
stages.subtitle: Live counts per approval stage. Click a stage to see its queue.

new_case.title: New case
new_case.subtitle: Create a draft case. The incident form is filled in next.
new_case.village_name_placeholder: Name of the village where the incident occurred
new_case.chef_de_village_placeholder: Full name of the village chief (witness)

ready.title: Ready to close
ready.subtitle: Cases already approved. Closing confirms the recipient has received the funds and marks the case terminal.
ready.empty: No approved cases waiting to be closed.

archive.title: Closed cases archive
archive.subtitle: Terminal — funds disbursed and receipt acknowledged.

modal.title: Close case
modal.warning: No further transitions will be allowed.

login.headline: HEC Emergency Fund.
login.tagline: Seamless payment service for human–elephant conflict compensation.

case.comment_placeholder: Add a comment (visible to all approvers)…
case.rejected_note: This case was rejected. Contact AB Entheos for next steps.
case.fill_form_hint: Fill the form on the left, then submit below.
case.admin_hint: As an administrator you can view this case and add comments, but cannot act on it. Only the current approver role ({role}) can advance.

actions.title: Actions
actions.defer_help: Send the case back one level for clarification or extra evidence. A comment is required.
actions.amount_decider: You are the amount-decider. Review the proposed amount, authorize or propose a new amount, then verify.
actions.amount_proposer: You are the amount proposer. Propose an amount before advancing.
actions.dgfc_propose_hint: Propose a draft amount for DGFAP to authorize. This is not yet locked.
actions.dgfap_authorize_hint: Authorize the final amount. This locks the amount for the rest of the chain.

defer_modal.title: Defer this case
defer_modal.body: The case will move back to step {to} ({role}) so they can add more context.
defer_modal.notes_placeholder: e.g. Please attach the village chief's statement before we can approve.

case.deferred_body: The previous approver sent this back to step {step} ({role}). Add a comment or update the case, then click Resume.
case.deferred_banner: Deferred from step {from} by {actor} — awaiting clarification.

gallery.title: Evidence gallery
gallery.subtitle: All photos and attachments, grouped by who uploaded them.
gallery.replace_body: This will upload a new version to replace "{{filename}}". The original file is retained in the per-slot history for audit purposes.

disbursements.no_proof: No proof of payment attached yet.
disbursements.replace_proof_hint: Upload a new file to replace the current proof.
disbursements.drop_or_click: Drop a file here or click to browse

files.title: Case files
files.subtitle: Supporting material uploaded to this case.
files.required_subtitle: Upload the mandatory supporting documents for this case. Files can be added or replaced progressively at any approval step.
files.upload_section_help: Choose the document type below, then upload the file.
files.load_error: Could not load attached files. Please refresh.
files.none_yet: No files attached yet. Use the upload form below.
files.replace_body: This will upload a new version to replace "{{filename}}". The original file is retained for audit and can be seen in the history below.
files.history_empty: No previous versions for this slot.
files.progressive_warning_body: This case was advanced with one or more required file slots still empty. They can be added by any approver at any later stage.

approve_modal.title: Approve this case?
approve_modal.body: The case will move to the next approver. Add an optional approval comment for the audit trail.
approve_modal.notes_placeholder: e.g. Verified ID and ambulance receipt, advancing to WCS.

reject_modal.title: Reject this case?
reject_modal.body: The case will be marked as rejected. A reason is optional but recommended.

close_modal.title: Close this claim?
close_modal.body: This action will close the case permanently. A closing comment is required for the audit trail.
close_modal.comment_placeholder: e.g. All disbursements completed. Treatment + transport fully paid.

case.submitted_hint: Case submitted. Click Verify to advance to the approval chain.
case.close_no_disbursements: At least one disbursement is required before closing.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Immutable record of every action on every case.

section.title: Recent events
section.body: The audit stream surfaces every state transition, comment, and upload with actor, role, IP and payload hash.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Quarterly and annual summaries, exportable as PDF and XLSX.

section.title: Latest reports
section.body: Generate, download and archive quarterly + annual reports. Includes totals and median time-to-approve.

forms.title: Form definitions
forms.subtitle: Publish and version the JSON-schema based intake forms used at each stage.

section.title: Published forms
section.body: Each form has a slug, version, JSON schema and a bilingual title. Publishing a new version snapshots the previous one.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Export approved amounts to CSV / SEPA and push to Moov / Airtel Money.

section.title: Pending disbursements
section.body: Filter by approver, case type and amount. Confirm payment once the recipient has received the funds.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Super-admin only: create users, assign roles, reset 2FA, impersonate.

section.title: Roster
section.body: Manage CBs, approvers, administrators and super-admins. Two-factor enrolment is mandatory for everyone except CB.

stages.title: Approval committee
stages.subtitle: End-to-end overview of every active case across the six approval stages.

section.title: Pipeline view
section.body: Cases grouped by current approval stage. Click any card to open the case workspace.

closed.title: Closed cases
closed.subtitle: Approve payments, mark cases as closed, and review the terminal archive.

quarterly.title: Quarterly report
quarterly.subtitle: Cases reported this quarter, by status, step and amount.

list.title: Published form definitions
list.subtitle: JSON-schema forms used at each approval stage. New versions snapshot the previous.

export.title: Export approved disbursements
export.subtitle: Generate a CSV or SEPA file for institutional providers (banks, mobile money operators).

approved.title: Approved cases
approved.subtitle: Send via mobile money or mark as paid.
